scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: One input is added in each of two successive ACP-backed repair calls and each candidate reaches the injected validator. The exact count test admits the second input at a two-input ceiling, then refuses a third input before dispatch, validation, or run creation. The exact byte test uses 3 bytes for the first retained input and 12 for the second, reaching a 15-byte ceiling; a third one-byte identifier is refused at 16 bytes. Both controls verify that previously retained corpus entries and digest remain unchanged, accepted source/head are preserved, and no attempt remains pending.
